verdict.rationale: Veo is operated mainly through natural-language prompts: text prompts become videos, and results can be refined over multiple turns with conversational editing such as element replacement or perspective changes. It is also reachable through the Gemini chat interface. Hands-on users confirm prompt-driven generation and prompted motion control, though several note that specific prompt details are often missed. Missing for 10: reliable fidelity to detailed prompt specifics, and evidence that non-generation operations (settings, workflow management) can be driven by natural language.
